hardware: Apple M4 Pro MacBook Pro, 24 GiB unified memory

runtime_provenance.measurement_note: EVO10 measurements used the archived source fingerprint for the then-dirty single-pass APC implementation.

b1_native_window.protocol: one fully cold run plus two fresh-process warm-prefix extensions
b1_native_window.reporting_note: The two warm arms are completion repeats, not independent fully cold prefills.

b2_ordered_warm_prefix_ceiling.reporting_note: All three attempts share the final retained shape but not identical prefill work. This is an ordered warm-prefix operational boundary.

measurement_definitions.decode_tps: aggregate first-to-last token rate over the common-active interval for B2; singleton first-to-last token rate for B1
measurement_definitions.page_high_water: simultaneously occupied fixed-pool page slots; not cumulative processed positions
